content.comment_body: Hello, good afternoon. Can someone help me with a [product_name] [version_no] 220V? I want to connect three pulse-emitting water meters and record water usage, but I'm new to this and not sure how to proceed. One meter is a Zenner model with EDC module, and the other two are Dosin types with 1 pulse per liter. Thank you.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please note that this is an English-speaking forum, so kindly submit your future posts in English. Thank you.

The [product_name] controller with AC220V supply does not feature fast counter inputs. Most pulse sensors typically require DC24V supply, so you would need a [product_name] [version_no] or a [product_name] [version_no] (without relays) for this setup. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is attempting to use a [product_name] [version_no] 220V model to record pulses from three water meters, but encounters hardware incompatibility. Community members highlight that the chosen device lacks fast counter inputs needed for this type of application and suggest opting for a DC input version of the [product_name]. This exchange reveals a common challenge for beginners: insufficient guidance on selecting suitable devices based on input requirements, which may lead to difficulties or incorrect purchases.
